default.description: Determines whether the tag is a default tag

displayName.description: Display name of the tag. It is one of 'Live', 'Test', 'Dev', 'Latest'

flowVersionId.description: Flow Version object ID to with which the tag is currently associated.

id.description: Identifier of the tag. It is one of 'Live', 'Test', 'Dev', 'Latest

versionNumber.description: Associated Flow Version object's version number
